matricula.descricao: Enrol in the Lúcia Maria School with no sign-up: three questions, no name, email or ID. Everything stays on your device.

carteirinha.descricao: The Lúcia Maria School card, made on your device. It is not an official document.

plano.descricao: A guilt-free study plan for the week, made on your device by simple rules.

comum.carregando: Opening what is stored on this device…
comum.semGuardar: This device did not allow saving (it may be the browser's private mode). Try outside it.

fluxo.lead: Three questions, no name, email or ID. The enrolment stays on this device.
fluxo.semVoz: This device has no voice to read aloud.
fluxo.baixarVoz: The chosen voice still needs to download {tamanho}. Download now?

terminar-a-escola.frase: Go back to studying what was left behind.

trabalho-e-renda.frase: Learn something that helps at work or with money.

entender-o-mundo.frase: Know why things are the way they are.

ajudar-em-casa.frase: Follow the studies of the people I live with.

outro.frase: I came to have a look, or it is something else.

tempo.pergunta: How much time a week do you have to study?
tempo.dica: Any answer is fine. You can change it later.

ate-1h.frase: A few minutes now and then.

1-3h.frase: A little, a few days a week.

acesso.dica: So the School uses less of your data, if needed.

pacote-acaba.frase: I use mobile data and it runs out before the month ends.

wifi-em-casa.frase: The internet at home is enough.

computador-ou-nucleo.titulo: I study on a computer or at a Núcleo
computador-ou-nucleo.frase: I use a computer, mine or a Núcleo's.

leve.texto: The site has a data saver (light mode): it hides images and videos and uses the device's own fonts. It is in the accessibility button.

nivelamento.pergunta: Want to find out where to start?
nivelamento.texto: A few short questions, no grade and no right or wrong on screen. They only suggest where to start. You can skip.
nivelamento.sim: Yes, I want to find out
nivelamento.semTeste: There are no placement questions for the School's courses yet. If you like, take the subject placement test later.

sugestao.texto: Suggested from your answers. Tick the ones you want; you can change later.
sugestao.semCursos: The School's courses are still being put together. The enrolment counts anyway: when they arrive, you choose.
sugestao.nenhumMarcado: No course ticked: the enrolment counts anyway.

motivo.pedido: The course you chose in the catalogue
motivo.comeco: Good to start: basic cycle, no prerequisite

sugestao.modulo1: Long course (about {horas} h). With up to 1 hour a week, start with module 1.
sugestao.nivelado: Has lessons from the subject the placement test suggested.
sugestao.antes: Before a long course, if you like

apelido.pergunta: What do you want to be called on the card?
apelido.dica: Optional. A nickname is enough: do not use your full name. Up to 40 letters. It stays on this device only.

feito.contagem: The School added an anonymous +1 to the enrolment count, without your number and without anything that says who you are.
feito.copia: Changed phones? Make a backup in My data.

gerir.refazerDica: Answer the questions again and choose courses. Your number and the courses you already have stay.
gerir.trancarDica: Pausing is taking a break. You can come back whenever you want.
gerir.apagarPergunta: Delete the enrolment, the courses, the plan for the week and everything the School stored on this device? There is no undo. The lessons you marked as done stay marked.

carteirinha.lead: Made on this device, with no server. To keep as a souvenir, print or show to your class.
carteirinha.avisoNaoDocumento: This card is not an official document and is not valid as a student card for half-price tickets (meia-entrada). It was made on this device; nothing was sent.
carteirinha.leiNaoVale: Half-price tickets require the Student ID Card (CIE), issued by the student organisations named in Brazilian Law no. 12.933/2013 (art. 1, § 2).
carteirinha.qr: Point the camera to visit the School
carteirinha.qrAlt: QR code with the address of the Lúcia Maria School
carteirinha.usarFotoDica: It only appears if your account has a photo stored on this device. Without it, your initials are used.
carteirinha.imprimirDica: When printing, choose actual size (100%) and no margins. Two card-sized pages come out: front and back.
carteirinha.falhou: Could not make the image on this device. Printing still works.

convite.titulo: You do not have an enrolment on this device yet
convite.texto: Enrolling takes three questions, no name, email or ID. Then the card appears here.

plano.lead: The next lessons of your courses, within the time you said you have. Made on this device.
plano.regra: Made by simple rules, with no artificial intelligence: lessons follow the order of each course, waived subjects are left out and the time is split across the days you choose.
plano.metaDaSemana: {n} lessons this week, from your goal in My studies
plano.hojeLivre: Today is a free day. If you feel like it, do a lesson from another day.
acolhimento: Busy week? That is fine, we adjust.
What did not fit today moves to the next study day.
One lesson at a time is already a path.

calma.texto: It has been two weeks with no lesson done. It happens to everyone. How about a plan with half the time?

plano.lembreteDica: Downloads a calendar file that reminds you on study days, even with the site closed. Nothing is sent.
plano.lembreteTitulo: Study at the Lúcia Maria School
plano.lembreteDescricao: Time for the plan of the week.
plano.acabou: You have done every lesson of your courses. How about choosing another?
plano.semCursos: To make the plan, join a course.

quemVolta.verPlano: See the plan for the week

convite.texto: Enrol: three questions, no name, email or ID.
